items.title: Built Record: Sports & Recreation with a cross laminated timber Focus
items.excerpt: Built Record — documented sports & recreation with editorial notes, imagery, and build details for research and precedent study.
items.content:
Built Record: Sports & Recreation with a cross laminated timber Focus documents a built work that continues to circulate in teaching studios and competition briefs. The project demonstrates how brief, climate, and procurement constraints were translated into a coherent spatial idea with legible tectonics.

Led by Lattice & Light, the scheme responds to Tokyo's regulatory and environmental context while maintaining a clear public-facing identity. Circulation, daylight, and material durability were coordinated early with engineers and specialists—an approach that later influenced regional guidance on similar building types.

This archive entry preserves photography credits, key metrics, and narrative context so researchers can compare approaches across decades. For contemporary teams, the lesson is less about copying details than about understanding decision sequencing: which moves were fixed early, and which remained flexible through construction.

Editors classify the work under recurring editorial tags—courtyard, limestone—to help readers discover related case studies across regions and scales.

faq.answer: Cite the9thedition archive URL, the project title, and the publication date shown on this page; verify on-site measurements with the original architect where required.
